format: OSwind frozen natural ASR import evaluation v2

dataset.license: CC BY 4.0 per official resource page
dataset.selection: First five lexicographic utterance IDs for EVERY available speaker in each test split, fixed before ASR inference; no result exclusions

normalization: Casefold, curly apostrophe to ASCII, ASCII alphanumeric words with internal apostrophes; punctuation discarded, no number expansion, spelling correction or NIST equivalence claim
import_failure_policy: Nonzero exit or per-import timeout is retained as a failed attempt. End-to-end WER scores missing delivered text as all reference-word deletions; successful-import WER is also reported separately. No failed clips are excluded or retried within a run.
reference_access: Reference bytes hashed before inference; reference text read for scoring only after the import subprocess completed; no transcript/reference prompts supplied
scope_limits: Frozen selected English audiobook utterances, not full LibriSpeech or meeting/noise/streaming recognition
Held out from OSwind tuning until this frozen run; upstream model-training overlap is unaudited
Complete CLI import per fresh process/library, including normalization, model load, admission and Apple embedding; not resident throughput
Core ML compute policy is requested, not proof every operation ran on that processor; whisper uses its default backend
Caches/background activity uncontrolled; process RSS excludes device allocations and child processes; no power/battery or competitor app ranking
No corpus audio, reference text or predictions are redistributed

prior_attempt.change: Only harness failure accounting: nonzero/timeout imports remain attempted rows, end-to-end WER all-deletions and successful-only WER separately. Exact same product/model/IDs/text normalization, no input exclusions/model tuning. Both failed attempts retained; this is a full new pass, not an unseen initial run.

execution_provenance.timing_context: No local Swift builds. Separate pinned synthetic Qwen soak and uncontrolled OS/Core ML caches/background. Small owned encrypted-disk capability proof ran during prior baseline speaker pass, unrelated to speaker quality.
execution_provenance.repairs_not_in_this_runner: PR35 source-bounding repair and PR34 library staging changes are separate drafts; this report uses the original signed binary, including its failed imports.
